page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-lc1m1.small is an entry-level, burstable virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features one vCPU and one physical core with a single thread, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 1.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a 1.0 GB memory-per-core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned in the lower tiers of compute capability. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU benchmarks both record a score of 1064.79. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 76.47 GB/sec, which decreases to 8.43 GB/sec for large uncached blocks and 6.75 GB/sec for write operations. The instance achieves a Passmark CPU score of 1212.67, while demonstrating 1.34 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and 1.28 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and minimal resource footprint, the instance offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for low-demand applications. It is suitable for low-traffic web serving, lightweight background tasks, basic microservices, and development environments. The lack of local storage and low baseline network bandwidth make it unsuitable for data-intensive workloads or persistent database hosting.
